params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3  Area: articles
Summary: Turn Blog into News and insights: articles, an FAQ and news items in one place, for example on the eIDAS deadline ("the regulatory window is open, are you ready").

## What is asked
- One section that holds the articles, the FAQ and short news items.
- News on regulation, such as the eIDAS timeline.

## Notes
- ISBE is not qualified yet; news on eIDAS must not suggest Bextrust already carries legal effect or an EU trust mark.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: Turn Blog into News and insights: articles, FAQ and news
